newsitem.title: USA: U.S. weekly corn, soybean exports hit highs.
newsitem.headline: U.S. weekly corn, soybean exports hit highs.

text.p: U.S. corn and soybean exports in the week ending Oct 24 hit marketing year highs, U.S. Agriculture Department said Thursday in its weekly Export Sales Report.
USDA said corn exports of 837,400 tonnes were 12 percent over the prior week and 23 percent higher than the four-week average.
Soybean exports of 699,300 tonnes were 17 percent higher than the previous week and double the four-week average.
